component.name: ChannelCatalogTask
component.script:
sub init() m.top.functionName = "loadCatalog" end sub
sub loadCatalog() m.top.errorMessage = "" if m.top.uri = "" m.top.errorMessage = "The channel catalog URL is not configured." return end if
response = fetchText(m.top.uri) if response.error <> "" m.top.errorMessage = response.error return end if
channels = ParseJson(response.body) if type(channels) <> "roArray" m.top.errorMessage = "The channel API must return a JSON array." return end if
catalog = createObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") for each channel in channels if type(channel) = "roAssociativeArray" appendChannel(catalog, channel) end if end for
if catalog.getChildCount() = 0 m.top.errorMessage = "The channel API returned no valid channels." return end if m.top.catalog = catalog end sub
function fetchText(uri as string) as object transfer = createObject("roUrlTransfer") transfer.setCertificatesFile("common:/certs/ca-bundle.crt") transfer.initClientCertificates() transfer.setUrl(uri) port = createObject("roMessagePort") transfer.setMessagePort(port)
if not transfer.asyncGetToString() return { body: "", error: "The channel API request could not be started." } end if
timeoutSeconds = m.top.timeoutSeconds if timeoutSeconds <= 0 then timeoutSeconds = 10 event = wait(timeoutSeconds * 1000, port) if event = invalid transfer.asyncCancel() return { body: "", error: "The channel API did not respond within " + timeoutSeconds.toStr() + " seconds." } end if if type(event) <> "roUrlEvent" transfer.asyncCancel() return { body: "", error: "The channel API returned an unexpected network event." } end if
body = event.getString() code = event.getResponseCode()
if code < 200 or code >= 300 return { body: "", error: "Channel API request failed with HTTP " + code.toStr() + "." } end if if body = "" then return { body: "", error: "The channel API returned an empty response." } return { body: body, error: "" } end function
sub appendChannel(parent as object, channel as object) title = getString(channel, "title") if title = "" then return
baseUrl = getString(channel, "baseUrl") if baseUrl <> "" channelUrl = ensureTrailingSlash(baseUrl) playlistUrl = channelUrl + "all" playlistType = "server-random" status = "online" else channelUrl = getString(channel, "url") playlistUrl = channelUrl playlistType = normalizePlaylistType(getString(channel, "playlistType")) status = getString(channel, "status") end if if channelUrl = "" then return
item = createObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") item.addFields({ playlistType: playlistType, playlistUrl: playlistUrl, totalNumOfVideos: getInteger(channel, "totalNumOfVideos"), totalPlaylistInMinutes: getFloat(channel, "totalPlaylistInMinutes"), currentIndex: getInteger(channel, "currentIndex"), tagsText: formatTags(channel), channelStatus: status }) item.url = channelUrl item.title = title item.description = getString(channel, "description") item.HDPosterUrl = randomThumbnail(channel) parent.appendChild(item) end sub
function ensureTrailingSlash(value as string) as string if value.right(1) = "/" then return value return value + "/" end function
function randomThumbnail(channel as object) as string candidates = [] keys = [ "thumbs", "thumbnails" ] for each key in keys if channel.doesExist(key) and type(channel[key]) = "roArray" for each thumbnail in channel[key] thumbnailType = type(thumbnail) if (thumbnailType = "roString" or thumbnailType = "String") and thumbnail.trim() <> "" candidates.push(thumbnail.trim()) end if end for else if channel.doesExist(key) and (type(channel[key]) = "roString" or type(channel[key]) = "String") if channel[key].trim() <> "" then candidates.push(channel[key].trim()) end if end for if candidates.count() = 0 and channel.doesExist("thumbnail") thumbnailType = type(channel.thumbnail) if thumbnailType = "roString" or thumbnailType = "String" if channel.thumbnail.trim() <> "" then candidates.push(channel.thumbnail.trim()) end if end if if candidates.count() = 0 then return "" index = 0 if candidates.count() > 1 then index = Rnd(candidates.count()) - 1 return resolveCatalogUrl(candidates[index]) end function
function resolveCatalogUrl(value as string) as string lowerUrl = LCase(value) if lowerUrl.left(7) = "http://" or lowerUrl.left(8) = "https://" then return value
parts = m.top.uri.split("/") if value.left(1) = "/" and parts.count() >= 3 return parts[0] + "//" + parts[2] + value end if return value end function
function normalizePlaylistType(value as string) as string result = LCase(value) if result = "m3u8" then return "m3u" return result end function
function formatTags(channel as object) as string if not channel.doesExist("tags") or channel.tags = invalid then return "" if type(channel.tags) = "roArray" then return channel.tags.join(", ") if type(channel.tags) = "roString" or type(channel.tags) = "String" then return channel.tags return "" end function
function getString(obj as object, key as string, fallback = "" as string) as string if obj.doesExist(key) and obj[key] <> invalid then return obj[key].toStr() return fallback end function
function getInteger(obj as object, key as string) as integer if obj.doesExist(key) and obj[key] <> invalid then return obj[key].toInt() return 0 end function
function getFloat(obj as object, key as string) as float if obj.doesExist(key) and obj[key] <> invalid then return obj[key].toFloat() return 0.0 end function
